description: This file defines the DataLabel class within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Shapes.Charts namespace, representing a label for data series in chart objects, with properties for formatting, style, position, and type. It also includes cloning and serialization methods.

classes.name: DataLabel
classes.description: Represents a data label with properties such as format, font, style, position, and type, used within chart series to annotate data points.
